privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Atelier by Vanaila Digital ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, how we store it, and your rights.

dataCollected.title: Data We Collect
items: Email address (for account creation and communication)
Hashed password (we never store plaintext passwords)
Usage logs (tool usage counts, timestamps, IP-derived region)
Billing records (transaction IDs, amounts, subscription status via Midtrans)

dataNotCollected.title: Data We Do NOT Collect
items: Your uploaded files (documents, images, PDFs)
All file processing happens entirely in your browser — files are never uploaded to our servers
We have no access to the content of your documents or images

storage.title: Data Storage
items: Account data: Cloudflare D1 (US region)
Pro cloud saves: Cloudflare R2 (encrypted, region-locked)
All data is encrypted at rest and in transit (TLS 1.3)

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
items: Midtrans — payment processing (card details handled by Midtrans, never stored on our servers)
Resend — transactional email delivery
PostHog — anonymised product analytics (no personal data shared)

rights.title: Your Rights
items: Access: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate personal data
Deletion: Delete your account and all associated data via DELETE /auth/account
Data portability: Request your data in a machine-readable format

pdp.title: Indonesia PDP Law Compliance
pdp.body: We comply with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP No. 27/2022). We process personal data lawfully, fairly, and transparently. You have the right to access, correct, delete, and port your personal data. We implement appropriate security measures and will notify you and the relevant authority in the event of a data breach.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliance (EU Users)
gdpr.body: For users in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, and Switzerland: We process personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Our legal basis for processing is contractual necessity (providing the service) and legitimate interest (analytics). You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions or data requests, contact us at privacy@vanailadigital.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Atelier by Vanaila Digital ("the Service"), you agree to these terms.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
items: You may not use the Service to generate or distribute illegal, harmful, or abusive content
You may not attempt to reverse-engineer, exploit, or circumvent rate limits
You may not abuse the free tier to replace a paid commercial service
You may not use automated scripts to access the Service

freePlan.title: Free Plan Limits
items: Authenticated users: 5 tool uses per day
Anonymous (no account) users: 3 tool uses per day
Limits reset daily at midnight UTC
Free plan includes all tools and export formats

proPlan.title: Pro Plan
items: Monthly subscription: $8/month or $72/year
Cancel anytime — your Pro access continues until the end of the current billing period
No partial-month refunds unless requested within 7 days of charge (see Refund Policy)
Pro features include brand kit storage, cloud history, AI drafting, and unlimited batch operations

oneTimePurchase.title: One-Time Purchases
items: One-time purchases are non-refundable once the file has been downloaded
A download constitutes delivery of the digital product

refundPolicy.title: Subscription Refunds
items: Pro-rata refund available within 7 days of a subscription charge
Refunds are processed via Midtrans within 5-7 business days
Contact us at billing@vanailadigital.com to request a refund

ip.title: Intellectual Property
items: You own all files you generate using the Service
We claim no ownership over your documents, images, or exports
The Service's code, templates, and design are owned by Vanaila Digital

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Jakarta, Indonesia.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: We want you to be satisfied with Atelier. This policy explains when refunds are available.

subscription.title: Subscription Refunds (Pro Plan)
items: You may request a refund within 7 days of your subscription charge date
Refunds are pro-rata based on the unused portion of your billing period
After the 7-day window, no further refunds are available for the current period
Cancellation stops future charges but does not auto-refund the current period

oneTime.title: One-Time Purchase Refunds
items: One-time purchases are non-refundable once the file has been downloaded
A download is considered delivery of the digital product
If you experience a technical issue preventing download, contact us for assistance

howToRequest.title: How to Request a Refund
items: Email billing@vanailadigital.com with your account email and transaction ID
We will respond within 2 business days
Refunds are processed via Midtrans within 5-7 business days
Refunds are credited to the original payment method
